Therefore, the race consisted of exactly 25 laps (10,000m / 400m). Furthermore, the Planner explicitly stated in Step 2 instructions that if the lap count was not explicitly listed, they should verify the distance and note if the source confirms a standard track measurement. By failing to verify the actual track length used in Winnipeg before concluding, the agent provided an inaccurate answer and prematurely ended the search process.
